title: spicerack.measures/1
description: The sidecar of a raw file spicerack.export wrote: its analyses and their .meas results.

spicerack.description: The version of spicerack that wrote the file.

backend.description: The simulator family that wrote every plot; null when they differ or are read from a file.

raw.description: The raw file's name, beside this file.

analyses.description: One entry per analysis, in the raw file's order.

index.description: The number of its first plot in the raw file, from 0; the plots of its steps follow it.

kind.description: op, dc, ac, tran, noise, tf, sens, pz, disto, pss, sp, hb, stb or trannoise; null for a plot read from a file.

plot.description: The Plotname of its first plot.

steps.description: null when the analysis is not stepped; else each step's parameters, in step order.

measures.description: The .meas results, ordered by analysis, step, then the deck's order.

analysis.description: Its analysis: a place in analyses, from 0.

step.description: Its step: a place in its analysis's steps; null when the analysis is not stepped.

reason.description: Why a measure that printed a value has none here.
